{{Quote|My side's secure.''"<Br />"''What have you got, Redeye?''"<Br />"''Redeye, you copy?|Mixer trying to contact a dead Redeye|audio=RedeyeDoYouCopy-VoT.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
'''Redeye''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] to protect [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from assassination attempts. While patrolling the ''Coronet''{{'s}} cargo hold, both he and Mixer were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Assassin probe|assassin droid]] as part of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]]'s failed [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|plot]] to kill Kryze. Redeye's body was briefly utilized as a decoy by the assassin droid. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'll check out the south quadrant.''"<Br />"''Careful over there, it's dark.''"<Br />"''Yeah, very funny, Mixer.|Redeye and Mixer|audio=VeryFunnyMixer-VoT.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
Redeye was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] on the water world of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the DNA of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. He served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was assigned to protect [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] onboard the ''Coronet''. While aboard the ship, Redeye was tasked with searching the ship's cargo bay for signs of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] infiltration, along with fellow trooper Mixer and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. While sweeping the cargo bay, he and Mixer split up. While investigating a noise, Redeye was startled by R2-D2, whom he chastised for pranking him. Shortly after this interaction, he was killed by an assassin droid that had snuck up behind him. Eventually, Mixer stumbled upon his [[DC-15S|blaster]], before being killed as well. Later on, the assassin droid attempted to use Redeye's body as a ruse to trick [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and threw his corpse at the Jedi after emerging from the shadows.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Droids|Redeye after R2-D2 startles him|<ref name="VoT" />}}
Like his genetic template, Redeye stood at 1.83 meters. Redeye appeared somewhat nervous and high-strung, as demonstrated by his reactions to fellow trooper Mixer's teasing and R2-D2’s pranks in the cargo hold.
